title.en: Ballotpedia reports 40 of 41 local data-center votes favored limits
title.zhHans: Ballotpedia 报告：41 项地方数据中心投票中 40 项倾向限制开发

searchSummary.en: Ballotpedia’s November 6 tally says voters favored data-center limits in 40 of 41 November 3 local contests; certification is not established.
searchSummary.zhHans: Ballotpedia 于 11 月 6 日统计，11 月 3 日 41 项地方投票中有 40 项倾向限制数据中心开发；尚不能据此认定结果已获认证。

summary.en: Ballotpedia reported on November 6 that voters favored limits in 40 of 41 local data-center ballot contests held November 3. Its breakdown counts 27 approvals of restrictive or oppositional measures and 13 rejections of pro-development measures; the lone exception was Harwood, North Dakota. Some votes were advisory rather than binding. This is a published results tally, not evidence that every jurisdiction had certified its final canvass or that every project was cancelled.
summary.zhHans: Ballotpedia 于 11 月 6 日报告，在 11 月 3 日举行的 41 项地方数据中心投票中，有 40 项的投票方向倾向限制开发。其分类为：27 项限制或反对开发的提案获通过，13 项支持开发的提案被否决；唯一例外是北达科他州 Harwood。部分投票仅具咨询性质。这是已公布的结果统计，不能证明每个辖区均完成最终认证，也不等于所有项目已经取消。

narrative.en: The node is dated November 6, the complete reported tally; election day was November 3. Results originate from Ballotpedia’s own aggregation, not 41 separately checked county certifications. “Favored limits” combines affirmative and negative votes, including non-binding questions, and must not be interpreted as 40 laws enacted.
narrative.zhHans: 节点以 11 月 6 日完整统计的披露日记录；投票发生于 11 月 3 日。结果来自 Ballotpedia 汇总，并非逐一核验了 41 份县级认证。“倾向限制”合并了赞成限制与反对放宽的不同投票，也包括非约束性问题，不能写成 40 部法律已经生效。

text.en: On November 6, Ballotpedia reported that 40 of 41 November 3 local data-center ballot results favored restrictions or opposition.
text.zhHans: Ballotpedia 于 11 月 6 日报告，11 月 3 日 41 项地方数据中心投票中有 40 项的结果倾向限制或反对开发。

text.en: The count includes advisory votes; this packet does not establish certification of all 41 local results or enactment of 40 binding laws.
text.zhHans: 统计包含咨询性投票；本轮未证明全部 41 项地方结果已完成认证，也不代表 40 部约束性法规已生效。
